# Bony Amin — Design Engineer

> I'm a design engineer. I help founders and companies build, modify and enhance their
> digital products. Design and engineering are both done by me, so there is no hand-off
> between the design and the code — and nothing gets lost in the middle.

## Who I work with
Businesses that already have a product or website, or want to build a new one entirely.
Founders, product leads and marketing owners commissioning a build.

## The three jobs I take
- Build — a new site, product or application from nothing.
- Modify — a redesign or rebuild of something that exists but no longer fits.
- Enhance — performance, accessibility and polish work on something already in use.

## What makes this different
One senior person covering design and engineering, so there is no account layer, no
hand-off week and no translation loss. Fixed price against fixed scope before work
starts. The client owns every design file, repository and account from day one. No
proprietary CMS and no lock-in. I work inside the client's existing stack and brand
rather than insisting on a rebuild.

## Services
- Marketing and product websites
- Web applications and product interfaces
- Design systems
- Redesign and rebuild of existing products
- Performance and accessibility enhancement
- Design and engineering audits
- Ongoing monthly design and development support

## Engagements
- Focused project — from $6,000, 2 to 3 weeks.
- Product build — $14,000 to $30,000, 4 to 8 weeks.
- Enhancement or audit — from $2,500, about a week.
- Ongoing support — from $3,500 per month, no minimum term.

## Working practice
One or two projects at a time. Asynchronous by default with a weekly live call. Replies
within one business day. Thirty days of post-launch support included with every project.
